reactor_type: horizontal reactor system (Thomas Swan Scientific Equipment single 2 in. wafer horizontal MOVPE reactor)
evidence: GaAs growth was performed in a horizontal reactor system (Thomas Swan Scientific Equipment single 2 in. wafer horizontal MOVPE reactor) maintained at 400 ° C and 200 torr using trimethylgallium (TMGa) and arsine (AsH3) as precursors. Alternating gas pulses of TMGa (3s) and AsH3 (8s) at flow rates of 5.3×10−5 and 4.5×10−3 mol min−1, respectively, were separated by a hydrogen purge (2s) to prevent the reactant gases from mixing in the gas phase.
